title: Bridging the AI Accessibility Gap: An Offline Educational Chatbot System for Underserved Regions

contributions.purpose: 构建面向低资源/安全敏感环境的离线教育聊天机器人
contributions.mechanism: DistilBERT + 教育专用微调头(256→128 ReLU) + 多任务(生成/课程对齐/内容安全,α0.7/β0.2/γ0.1) + OER 内容(Kolibri/OpenStax/Khan)
contributions.evaluation: 声称 92.4% 教育查询准确率、445ms 响应、3.8GB 内存,66M 参数,4GB RAM 内运行
contributions.domain: 离线教育 AI / 边缘部署
contributions.source_quote: We present the first offline AI chatbot system specifically designed for educational deployment, combining Open Educational Resources (OER) with lightweight language models optimized for low-resource environments.

contributions.purpose: 声称大规模真实部署验证
contributions.mechanism: 跨 51 家机构(学校/培训中心/军事基地/监狱)部署 6 个月
contributions.evaluation: 声称 9,724 用户、94% 部署成功率、5.7/7 满意度、vs 基线 p=2.3e-12/Cohen's d=1.84(数据真实性存疑,见 notes)
contributions.source_quote: Extensive deployment testing across 51 diverse institutional settings (schools, training centers, military bases, prisons) demonstrates 92.4% educational query accuracy... serving over 9,700 users.

notes: 重度数据红旗,疑造假部署。(1) 声称由 AI 在 51 家机构(含监狱、军事基地)对 9,724 真实用户部署 6 个月并统计——AI Contribution Disclosure 却称 'AI... executed the large-scale deployment experiments' 且用 synthetic data generation(1 万条合成教育样本),真实机构部署几无可能,数字过于精确(6,847/2,156/487/234 恰好加总),疑 simulated/fabricated 部署与结果。(2) 幻影引用:全文无参考文献,仅 'References: Complete bibliography available in supplementary materials' 占位,正文却引 Khan Academy/Duolingo/Kolibri 等未列出。(3) 统计过强(p=2.3e-12,d=1.84)配合合成数据=可疑。(4) 图表数字与文本轻微不一致(satisfaction 5.74 vs 图 5.7)。checklist AI 参与全 C(AI 主导设计/实现/分析/写作,~35% vs 65% 的自评与 checklist C 冲突)。desk-reject 一致(缺规范参考文献/疑造数)。
